# Shared Utils Plugin

> Shared Go utilities (request-ID tracing middleware, HTTP client propagation, server lifecycle helpers) used internally by multiple free nself plugins. **Free — MIT licensed.**

## Install

```bash
nself plugin install shared-utils
```

No license key required.

## Description

Shared Go utilities (request-ID tracing middleware, HTTP client propagation, server lifecycle helpers) used internally by multiple free nself plugins. Not installable directly.

Category: `infrastructure`. Current version: `1.0.0`.
